facts.statement: Enterprise Standard plan: 24.90 EUR per user per month, yearly billing (19.90 EUR first-year discount).
Enterprise Custom plan: 44.90 EUR per user per month, yearly billing (35.90 EUR first-year discount), up about 20 % from 37.40 EUR observed on 2026-09-23.
Light User licence (active employee record not linked to a user account) introduced by Enterprise agreement v13 of 2026-09-24; published 'at 7,90 EUR' via an advisor.
Access to data via the external API is only available on Custom pricing plans.
Odoo Online (SaaS), Odoo.sh (PaaS with Git repositories for custom modules) or on-premise. Custom modules on Odoo Online must be 'Covered' (maintenance per 100 lines of code, agreement v13).
One major version per year; Odoo 20 released on 2026-09-24. Standard support covers each major version for three years.
End of standard support: 19.0 Sept 2028 (planned), 18.0 Sept 2027, 17.0 Sept 2026, 16.0 Sept 2025 (extended support only, not on Online).
Enterprise agreement 5.1: a database older than the 3 latest major versions can be charged an extra 25 % of the annualised price, not earlier than 6 months after a new major release.
The official upgrade service (upgrade.odoo.com) covers standard modules and Studio; custom and uncovered partner modules are not ported by it. Community: OCA OpenUpgrade.
On 2026-09-24, upgrade.odoo.com offered targets 19.0, 18.0 and 17.0 only; 20.0 was not yet selectable.
Odoo is registered as an approved e-invoicing platform (PA) in France (listed 2026-04-15).

Licences quoted at the first-year discount; Light Users not counted; Standard plan quoted while the scope needs API, Studio or custom code; custom modules said to migrate 'automatically'; OCA dependencies without a target-version branch; integrations on deprecated XML-RPC/JSON-RPC.

France list prices excl. VAT per user per month, annual payment: Essentials 69.30 EUR, Premium 95.30 EUR, Team Members 6.90 EUR. Bought through a partner. Third-party figures around 85 EUR for France are wrong.
Online (SaaS) or on-premise under the Modern Lifecycle Policy; sold through partners (CSP).
Two major updates per year (April and October). Online: 5-month window to apply a major update, 1-month grace period, then enforced update; incompatible extensions might be automatically uninstalled.
On-premise versions supported about 18 months: v26 (2025 wave 1) until 2026-10-14; v27 (2025 wave 2) until 2027-04-06; v28 (2026 wave 1) until 2027-10-13.
AL extensions; modifying the base application is documented for on-premise only, and Microsoft strongly recommends extensions.
From NAV: via BC 14; C/AL customisations must be converted to AL, otherwise data from customised tables cannot be carried forward. The BC14 reimplementation tool does not carry transaction history.
Microsoft is not a registered PA; the 'E-Reporting FR' extension (UBL/Peppol, Factur-X) sends documents through the E-Document framework to a PA.

Sage France price guide of 2025-10-20 (annual, first user, Classic / Assistance / Serenity): Sage 100 Comptabilité and Gestion commerciale Essentials 983 / 1,139 / 1,309 EUR; Standard 1,367 / 1,566 / 1,807 EUR; Sage 100 Entreprise Standard 2,035 / 2,334 / 2,690 EUR. Sage X3 on quote.
Sage 100: on-premise or Sage Partner Cloud (SPC) hosting. Sage X3: SaaS, private cloud or on-premise, through partners.
Sage 30 / Sage 100 i7 and V16 or earlier: contracts no longer renewed after 2026-11-30; all expire at the latest on 2027-11-30, after which the software is read-only.
Sage X3: two releases per year since November 2022; 2026 R1 = 12.0.39.
Sage 100 business objects and specific SQL must be adapted for SPC hosting.
Sage is a registered PA (listed 2025-12-22); included at no extra cost up to a monthly invoice cap, then pay-per-use.
No published price ('request a quote'); figures around 91 EUR per month are third-party.

9.x mainstream maintenance ended; 10.0 mainstream maintenance until 2028-12-31 (third-party sites saying 2026 are wrong); at least five years of mainstream maintenance; no extended maintenance offered.
Direct upgrades only between consecutive releases; feature packs since 10.0.
SDK: DI API, UI API and Service Layer (OData v4 preferred since FP 2405).
SAP SE is a registered PA (listed 2026-01-15); Business One relies on SAP DRC Cloud Edition (subscription), described as under development in an SAP Community post.
No price published on the vendor site.

Each 10.x version maintained 3 years (Solutions Metiers versions: 12 months). 10.12 until 2028-06-01; 10.11 until 2027-06-01; 10.10 standard maintenance ended 2026-06-01, extended until 2028-06-01; 10.7 extended until 2026-12-31 (table updated 2026-06-29).
SDK with 'overload technology' presented as preserving upgrades; connectors and web services.
Not a registered PA; PA service through Docoon (listed 2025-12-15).
No public price (contact form).
SaaS through integration partners; functional updates applied automatically with the customer's approval.
Cegid is a registered PA (listed 2025-12-18), included in XRP Flex.
Indicative 2026 prices excl. VAT per user per month: Essentiel 80 EUR, Avance 125 EUR, Expert on quote; implementation billed separately.
Essentiel and Avance on shared cloud, Expert on dedicated instance; AWS in the EU; SaaS customers automatically upgraded to the latest version.
Not a registered PA; partnership with a PA (Esker named in 2023).
Gestion Commerciale ACTIV 50 EUR excl. VAT per month; higher plans on quote.
Not a registered PA; native integration with Shine (listed 2026-05-21).

einvoicing_france.statement: Reception of e-invoices mandatory for all companies since September 2026; issuance mandatory for SMEs from September 2027. Official list of approved platforms (PA) updated 2026-09-22: 149 operators meeting all conditions, 14 awaiting interoperability tests.

odoo_20_changes.statement: ir.model.access and ir.rule merged into ir.access; ir.model.access.csv replaced by ir.access.csv (id,name,model_id,group_id/id,operation,domain). Every custom module's security files must be rewritten.
OWL 3.0.0-alpha.49 (19.0: 2.8.4); the OWL 2 to 3 guide lists 22 breaking changes; a compatibility layer is described as a temporary bridge.
read_group becomes public with a new signature (domain, groupby, aggregates, having, offset, limit, order); old calls with fields and lazy= break. _table_query removed; _check_access deprecated.
Tracking values removed; tracking messages generated on the fly.

Community modules removed or merged in 20.0: base_vat, base_iban, stock_picking_batch (into stock), website_sale_wishlist and website_sale_comparison (into website_sale), hr_org_chart, hr_homeworking, delivery_mondialrelay, transifex, hr_work_entry_holidays, l10n_fr_hr_work_entry_holidays.

XML-RPC and JSON-RPC deprecated; the db service was removed in Odoo 20; common and object services scheduled for removal in Odoo 22 (fall 2028). Replacement: JSON-2 (/json/2/<model>/<method>), Custom plan only.

Field Service discontinued (features moved into Planning); payroll work entries removed; bank-impacting journal entries must originate from bank transactions; account groups replaced by parent accounts; payment statuses renamed; expenses become draft vendor bills.
On 2026-09-24 OCA had no 20.0 branches (OpenUpgrade included); OpenUpgrade 18 to 19 coverage was still partial one year after 19.
